lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Excuse me, can I ask you something?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Sure. How can I help you?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: I need to get to my hotel in Manhattan. What's the best way?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: You have a few options. Taxis and ride-sharing are direct, but public transit is cheaper.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Is public transit easy with luggage?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It's not too bad. The train has space for bags, and it goes right into the city.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Okay, that sounds good. I'll take the train then.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Good choice. Just follow the signs for the train. Have a nice trip!

carry_in: Jieun is at the ground transportation area considering her options
She is comparing taxi, ride-sharing, and public transit
She is unsure which option is the most practical
carry_out: Jieun has received advice from a transit employee
She has decided to take public transit to Manhattan
She is now heading toward the transit station
scene_state.emotion: more confident and decided after receiving advice
